Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you
reported. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just get to what happened, but fine. It's on the recording, so I'll give you what you need.
Q: Understood. Can you describe where you were when the collision occurred?
A: I was in Pasadena, Texas, driving my car. I was making a left turn at an intersection with a traffic light. The light
had been green for me, or at least I thought it was.
Q: Which direction were you traveling, and what did you do before the turn?
A: I was heading north and wanted to turn west. I solwed down, checked for oncoming traffic, and started into the
intersection. There was a car coming from the other direction, and I thought it had room to stop.
Q: What happened next?
A: It didn't stop. It came through and hit the front passenger side of my car. My airbag went off and the impact threw
me against the door and then back into the seat.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: Did you get out of the vehicle, and did you seek medical attention?
A: I got out with help. The paramedics came, and I went to the emergency room that evening. They said I had a
shoulder injury, probably from the setabelt and the door. I've been going to physical therapy since.
Q: Have you had any prior injuries to that shoulder?
A: No, nothing serious. I had some soreness years ago from lifting, but nothing that needed treatment.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything you'd like to add before we conclude?
A: Just that I'd like this handled quickly. I'm still having trouble lifting things, and I'm worried about missing work.
Q: We'll follow up on that. Thank you for your time today.
</page>

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
